parse_mujoco_skin_file: parse a MuJoCo skin file from bytes into a Skin namedtuple with vertices, texcoords, faces, and bones
serialize_skin_to_bytes: serialize a Skin namedtuple into bytes representing a MuJoCo skin file for disk or network I/O
create_skin_namedtuple: create a Skin namedtuple with vertices, texcoords, faces, and bones arrays for MuJoCo skin data
create_bone_namedtuple: create a Bone namedtuple with body, bindpos, bindquat, vertex_ids, and vertex_weights for skin rigging
review_skin_parse_serialize: review the parse and serialize functions for MuJoCo skin file binary format round-trip correctness
